title: GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex minimization of f:E→ℝ with an attained global minimum. Some minimizer xstar satisfies ‖x0−xstar‖≤R and f(x0)−f(xstar)≤Δ; R,Δ>0. Strong convexity is not required.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree.lean: spec.admissible, ConvexOn and existential IsMinOn conditions.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x∈E returns exactly ∇f(x), for every call index and oracle seed. Replies contain no function values or Hessians. There is no oracle error or noise; seed dependence cannot change the unique gradient. The budget counts every gradient query and is fixed, rather than expected.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible HasGradientAt condition; LongTails/Template.lean: execute, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: unknown_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only E, its real Hilbert-space structure, x0, and an arbitrary h0>0 are public. L0,L1,R,Δ,ε are hidden from algorithm construction; they specify admissibility, accuracy, and the external execution budget.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm and budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient map is Fréchet differentiable everywhere and satisfies ‖D(∇f)(x)‖≤L0+L1‖∇f(x)‖, with L0>0 and L1≥0. No global gradient Lipschitz constant is assumed when L1>0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible Differentiable and fderiv conditions.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space, including infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. Initialization bounds concern one common minimizer; no bounded domain, bounded solution set, or globally bounded gradient is required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree.lean: Public.normedE, Public.linearE, Public.completeE and spec.admissible existential minimizer condition.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output is a point in E satisfying f(output)−f(xstar)≤ε for a global minimizer xstar, with ε>0.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law. The successful predicate does not require a deterministic algorithm.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree.lean: spec.successful ∀ᵐ condition; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence product probability measure.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines gradient-dependent curvature, hidden smoothness and initialization parameters, gradient-only information, and arbitrary Hilbert-space geometry. These are meaningful variants of the usual known-L smooth convex benchmark.

descriptionHtml:
Convex Minimization with Hidden Smoothness

We consider minimizing a convex function f:E→R on a real Hilbert space E. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth with hidden constants L0>0 and L1≥0, and has a differentiable gradient. A given point x0∈E satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ for a global minimizer x⋆ and hidden bounds R,Δ>0. The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E satisfying f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, and ∥⋅∥op denotes the induced operator norm. The algorithm receives only E, x0, and a scalar h0>0; the parameters L0,L1,R,Δ, and ε may enter the oracle-call budget but are not algorithm inputs.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity). For every x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y).

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, and its gradient ∇f:E→E is Fréchet differentiable everywhere. Its Hessian ∇2f(x):E→E satisfies ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥,x∈E.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance and objective gap). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output must satisfy f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤εP-a.s. The minimizer x⋆ is fixed independently of the algorithm’s randomness.

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function
import LongTails.Template

namespace LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  x0 : E
  h0 : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.linearE Public.completeE

structure Params extends Public where
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.h0 ∧ 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f oracle :=
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f ∧
    (∀ k seed x, HasGradientAt f (oracle.answer k (0, x) seed) x) ∧
    (∀ k seed, Differentiable ℝ (fun x => oracle.answer k (0, x) seed)) ∧
    (∀ k seed x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => oracle.answer k (0, y) seed) x‖ ≤
      q.L0 + q.L1 * ‖oracle.answer k (0, x) seed‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
      f q.x0 - f xstar ≤ q.Δ)
  successful q f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _), f (output ω) - f xstar ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothParameterFree
